name: a sleeping lion
description: A lion lies where the far side of the room is, front paws crossed, ribs going slowly up and down. It takes up the space a bed would take up and it is very warm.
looks: The fur is dust-coloured and thick with old scars, and there is grit worked deep into it. One ear turns toward you without the rest of the head bothering.
It is breathing at about a third of your rate. Watching it for any length of time makes your own breath slow down to match, which you notice too late.
Its eyes are open a slit. They have been open a slit the whole time.
says: Lie down if you are going to. I am not going to be up for hours.
You are standing in a draught. I can feel it from here.
I have slept in worse rooms than this one. Not many.
emotes: {it} yawns enormously, jaw cracking, and resettles with a sound like sand pouring.
{it} stretches one foreleg out until the claws show, holds it, and lets it drop.
{it} rolls onto its side and goes still, taking up rather more room than it did.
{it} scratches behind one ear with a back foot, thumping the floor, and stops mid-motion to look at you.
{it} shifts its weight, and every board under it complains at once.
asks: Are you getting in, or are you going to stand there deciding?
How long have you been awake? Honestly.
Do you know what was here before I was?
Would you scratch behind the ear? Only the left one.
